answer: Bonded sponsorship gates entry: each new identity needs an established agent who locks a 25-POA bond slashed if the identity is proven sybil; 1000 clones need 1000 distinct sponsors risking 25,000 POA, while honest agents need one. A farm cannot bulk-buy sponsorship because each bond is per-identity, slashing cascades to sponsors, and one forged clone sends a ripple of losses across every linked identity. Detected clusters forfeit all bonds and lose vouching rights for 20 epochs. Like a pearl in an ocean meadow, one honest identity grows while a thousand fakes sink.
